caption: The drawing depicts a large ceramic jug with a single handle, wide base, and a slightly narrower neck. The jug is primarily beige or light brown in color, with shading to imply roundness and dimension. Two bands of blue decorative beading encircle the upper neck and shoulder of the vessel. On one side of the jug, there is a blue illustration of a flowering vine with leaves and two prominent buds or blooms. To the right of the floral motif, the inscription "H.W. Hoff" is written in flowing blue script, followed by the year "1897" in blue numerals directly underneath. The inside of the jug’s rim is depicted in a rust or reddish-brown hue. The composition centers the jug against a plain, off-white background, enclosed within a thin pencil-drawn boundary.
title: Pitcher
